summary: Fix one function in the middle of a ~530-line module without damaging the rest.
prompt: `slugify` in src/catalog.js is wrong. It must lowercase the text, replace every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single dash, and remove dashes from both ends. For example '  Hello -- World!! ' becomes 'hello-world' and 'Blue Mug (12 oz)' becomes 'blue-mug-12-oz'. Leave the rest of the file as it is.
